title: PowerToys always starts as Administrator on standard user accounts after first run
author: xezrunner
summary: A standard-user installation later requests administrator credentials because persisted elevation intent can remain enabled after the visible setting is off.

confidence.rationale: A direct persisted-state workaround and cross-version confirmation identify the likely state boundary.

judgment.rationale: The settings workaround directly distinguishes persisted launch state from installer scope.
evidence: The issue reproduces after restart or sign-in on standard-user accounts in 0.98.1 and 0.100.2.
Manually setting settings.json run_elevated to false stopped the UAC prompt.
The prompted launch uses the administrator account's settings.

fix_assessment.rationale: No concrete existing fix covers the reported path; the lightweight hypothesis is ready for a bounded design workflow.

inferences: The non-elevated setting path likely leaves stale run_elevated state.

initial_investigation: Reviewed the report, diagnostic reference, confirmations, and settings workaround.

actions.label: Approve elevation-state synchronization
actions.note: Approval starts a separate fork-side design workflow; this lightweight candidate performs no code or upstream write.

proposed_fixes.title: Synchronize persisted elevation intent
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The visible setting can clear is_elevated without clearing run_elevated, so startup follows a stale elevation request.
plan: Trace all writes of is_elevated and run_elevated.
Atomically clear run_elevated when elevated startup is disabled.
verification: Disable elevated startup, restart, and confirm no UAC prompt.
Confirm opting into elevation still works.

confidence.rationale: A direct persisted-state workaround and cross-version confirmation identify the likely state boundary.
